  "phoneNote": "The restrained typography reads clearly, but repeated address and opening-hours blocks make the phone page longer and more repetitive than necessary.",

  "fixes": [
    "Correct the sticky navigation positioning so it cannot cover the desktop headline or phone contact content, while preserving the required phone call/directions bar.",
    "Keep one complete address-and-hours block and remove its duplicate; retain only a concise contact shortcut near the introduction.",
    "Tighten the desktop section padding and give the translator’s name and language specialism a more distinctive typographic treatment instead of another large introductory heading."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Desktop full-page view: the navigation bar overlaps and obscures the hero headline.",
    "Phone full-page view: the navigation and action bar cover the telephone block.",
    "Phone and desktop: the address and opening-hours block is repeated near the top and again above the footer."
  ]
